fit_circle_in_3d: fit a circle to 3D points and optionally generate new points along the fitted circle
fit_circle_in_2d: fit a circle to 2D points and optionally generate new points along the fitted circle
get_rotation_to_best_fit_xy: compute a rotation matrix that levels a batch of 3D points to best fit the XY plane
test_signed_area: test the signed area calculation for 2D polygons including circles, semicircles, and L shapes
test_circle_fitting: run unit tests for circle fitting functions including 2D fitting, 3D fitting, and plane levelling
